Accountant Job at Jobvet Services




        
    

        
        Jobvet Services - Our client, a Leading Plastic Sack Manufacturing Company is seeking to recruit suitably qualified candidates for the position below: 

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Yola, Adamawa
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The Account Officer will be responsible for managing financial records and ensuring accurate reporting, contributing to the company's financial health and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Maintain financial records and prepare financial statements.
	Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
	Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
	Assist in budgeting and forecasting processes.
	Perform reconciliations and resolve discrepancies.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	Proven experience in accounting or finance roles.
	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 / month.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Senior Business Development Manager",
  "description": "TDL is a well established full service Internet provider. We offer the best managed dedicated server solutions available combined with unbeatable support and maintenance. Since 1994, TDL has Hosted thousands of web sites for business, ecommerce, the entertainment industry and non-profits. We look forward to becoming your reliable service provider.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Business Development Manager&nbsp;

Job Locations: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time&nbsp;

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Business Development Manager to lead and develop a high-performing sales team. This is a first-line leadership role responsible for driving business growth by helping SMEs engaged in international trade navigate cross-border transactions.
	The successful candidate will coach and mentor a team of sales representatives, driving customer acquisition through a combination of telemarketing and face-to-face engagements while promoting the Company&#39;s suite of cross-border collection, payment, foreign exchange settlement, and risk management solutions.


Responsibilities
Team Leadership &amp; Management:


	Lead, coach, and manage a team of 5&ndash;10 Sales of Representatives, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and results-oriented culture.
	Take full ownership of the team&#39;s daily sales operations, including monitoring performance metrics and ensuring compliance with sales processes and activity standards.
	Conduct regular field coaching, ride-alongs, and joint client visits to support team members in closing deals and overcoming customer objections.
	Motivate and inspire the team by creating a positive work environment that encourages accountability, continuous improvement, and a &quot;can-do&quot; attitude.
	Identify training and development needs to continuously improve team capability and performance.


Sales Strategy &amp; Execution:


	Develop and execute local go-to-market strategies to acquire new B2B clients, particularly SMEs engaged in international trade.
	Drive customer acquisition through a combination of high-volume telemarketing, strategic face-to-face meetings, referrals, and networking activities.
	Understand clients&#39; cross-border payment and foreign exchange requirements and recommend tailored solutions that support their international business growth.
	Leverage sales data and market insights to improve sales efficiency, optimise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and refine sales strategies.
	Ensure the team consistently meets or exceeds assigned sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Business Development &amp; Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline by identifying and pursuing high-potential business opportunities.
	Develop and nurture relationships with B2B traders, freight forwarders, logistics companies, trade associations, and other strategic partners.
	Expand the Company&#39;s market presence through networking events, industry engagements, and strategic partnerships.
	Utilise digital platforms and social media channels to support lead generation and customer acquisition initiatives.


Communication &amp; Reporting:


	Effectively communicate company strategies, product updates, policies, and sales initiatives to the team.
	Serve as the link between the sales team and senior management by providing regular reports on sales performance, market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities.
	Recommend improvements based on market intelligence to support business growth and strategic decision-making.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales management with a proven track record of successfully leading a team of at least five sales professionals.
	Strong experience in B2B sales, with exposure to industries such as FinTech, SaaS, Banking, International Trade, Cross-Border Payments, Taxation, or Logistics considered a strong advantage.

Senior Business Development Manager Job at Total Data Limited




        
    

        
        TDL is a well established full service Internet provider. We offer the best managed dedicated server solutions available combined with unbeatable support and maintenance. Since 1994, TDL has Hosted thousands of web sites for business, ecommerce, the entertainment industry and non-profits. We look forward to becoming your reliable service provider.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Business Development Manager 

Job Locations: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Business Development Manager to lead and develop a high-performing sales team. This is a first-line leadership role responsible for driving business growth by helping SMEs engaged in international trade navigate cross-border transactions.
	The successful candidate will coach and mentor a team of sales representatives, driving customer acquisition through a combination of telemarketing and face-to-face engagements while promoting the Company's suite of cross-border collection, payment, foreign exchange settlement, and risk management solutions.


Responsibilities
Team Leadership & Management:


	Lead, coach, and manage a team of 5–10 Sales of Representatives, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and results-oriented culture.
	Take full ownership of the team's daily sales operations, including monitoring performance metrics and ensuring compliance with sales processes and activity standards.
	Conduct regular field coaching, ride-alongs, and joint client visits to support team members in closing deals and overcoming customer objections.
	Motivate and inspire the team by creating a positive work environment that encourages accountability, continuous improvement, and a "can-do" attitude.
	Identify training and development needs to continuously improve team capability and performance.


Sales Strategy & Execution:


	Develop and execute local go-to-market strategies to acquire new B2B clients, particularly SMEs engaged in international trade.
	Drive customer acquisition through a combination of high-volume telemarketing, strategic face-to-face meetings, referrals, and networking activities.
	Understand clients' cross-border payment and foreign exchange requirements and recommend tailored solutions that support their international business growth.
	Leverage sales data and market insights to improve sales efficiency, optimise Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and refine sales strategies.
	Ensure the team consistently meets or exceeds assigned sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Business Development & Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline by identifying and pursuing high-potential business opportunities.
	Develop and nurture relationships with B2B traders, freight forwarders, logistics companies, trade associations, and other strategic partners.
	Expand the Company's market presence through networking events, industry engagements, and strategic partnerships.
	Utilise digital platforms and social media channels to support lead generation and customer acquisition initiatives.


Communication & Reporting:


	Effectively communicate company strategies, product updates, policies, and sales initiatives to the team.
	Serve as the link between the sales team and senior management by providing regular reports on sales performance, market trends, customer feedback, and competitor activities.
	Recommend improvements based on market intelligence to support business growth and strategic decision-making.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales management with a proven track record of successfully leading a team of at least five sales professionals.
	Strong experience in B2B sales, with exposure to industries such as FinTech, SaaS, Banking, International Trade, Cross-Border Payments, Taxation, or Logistics considered a strong advantage.
	Demonstrated success in driving sales growth, developing high-performing teams, and achieving ambitious revenue targets.
	Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
	Excellent negotiation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.
	Highly self-motivated, target-driven, resilient, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret sales data and make informed business decisions.


Preferred Qualifications:


	Existing network within the SME, import/export, or international trade ecosystem.
	Experience selling cross-border payment, foreign exchange, fintech, or financial services solutions.
	Hands-on experience using CRM systems, sales analytics tools, and social media for business development and lead generation.
	Ownership of a personal vehicle is an added advantage.


Benefits


	Competitive monthly base salary: Basic: 521,000.00
	Attractive unlimited team commission structure: KPI/Bonus(N):279,000.00
	Monthly earnings from ?800,000 and above (performance-based)
	Career growth opportunities
	Training and continuous support

	Nikemfol Limited is seeking a proactive and organized Administrative Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of the office.

	Manage office files, records, and documentation.

	Schedule meetings and maintain calendars.
	Prepare reports, letters, and other office documents.
	Maintain office supplies and coordinate purchases when needed.
	Assist with data entry and record keeping.
	Welcome visitors and provide general administrative support.
	Perform other administrative duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
	Strong organizational and time-management skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
